messages:
anya: Heads-up: after the recent exports cleanup in js-sdk, our Next/Vite starter and VSCode TS hints broke. Repro + quick logs below, tagging @matt for bundler parity and @zara for packaging.

anya: Minimal repro:
1) npx create-next-app@latest --typescript demo && cd demo
2) yarn add @redwood/js-sdk@latest
3) import { createClient } from '@redwood/js-sdk' in a page -> dev server fails to resolve package

anya: Shipped package.json snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/js-sdk",
  "version": "0.7.0",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
    },
    "./client": "./dist/esm/client.mjs",
    "./server": "./dist/cjs/server.cjs"
  }
}
```

anya: Vite error:
[vite] Failed to resolve entry for package "@redwood/js-sdk". The package may have incorrect "exports" or "module" field.

matt: This is the usual interplay: many bundlers and editors expect .js ESM files or explicit per-subpath conditionals. Using only .mjs/.cjs in exports can confuse Vite, Bun, and some editors. Also TS prefers `types` on each exported subpath.

zara: Short-term workaround for starters: deep import `@redwood/js-sdk/dist/esm/index.js` and add a tsconfig path mapping so editors find declarations. Not ideal for onboarding but unblocks users.

zara: Quick patch plan: publish 0.7.1 that reverts strict .mjs/.cjs-only exports and reintroduces .js fallbacks plus per-export `types`. Example change:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"},
  "./client": {"import":"./dist/esm/client.js","require":"./dist/cjs/client.js","types":"./dist/client.d.ts"},
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

matt: Also adding a CI smoke job that validates resolution with Node resolver + esbuild + vite dev build across examples before publishing. We'll gate publish on that.

release-bot: Published patch @redwood/js-sdk v0.7.1: "fix: add .js fallbacks and per-export types to improve bundler/editor compatibility"

anya: Thanks! I'll update the starter README with the interim deep-import tip and mark the issue with the patch linked.

matt: Follow-up: schedule a 30m devex sync to codify export-map guidelines across SDKs (explicit subpaths, avoid wildcard, per-export types, .js fallbacks).
